slug: 2024-12-24 Morocco's DGSN issued 4.6 million electronic national IDs in 2024 (annual report)

systems.tiers: Online portal launched in 2024 for criminal-record requests and appointment scheduling
Online-crime reporting platform; 12,614 reports received since its June 2024 launch, per the DGSN's 2024 annual report

note: Summary of the DGSN's 2024 annual report: identity cards, an identity verification platform, and two portals for the public. A portal through which the public reports or asks for a certificate is the public class. Nothing on how a station records a report or a case.
